Idiomatic C# bindings for CUI, the 160-component native UI library written in C99. Immediate-mode UI in C#, no XAML and no managed UI framework, with a 1.5 MB NativeAOT single-file output.
dotnet new templates for CuiSharp: a native desktop app in plain C# with no XAML and no managed UI framework, scaffolded as a solution with a demo app and a test project.
Drive a CuiSharp interface without a window: find a control by its label, click it, type into it, and assert on the frame it produced. Reference it from a test project only.
Screenshot a CuiSharp app, print the controls of its last frame, and click or type into it - without a window, an agent or a test project.

Image resizing for Oluso public assets. Isolates the image library behind IImageResizer; the default implementation uses SkiaSharp (MIT-licensed) as a local/dev resize shim that mirrors Cloudflare Image Resizing's options. Azure-based webhook processing for Oluso identity platform. Provides queue-based webhook retry processing using Azure Storage Queues or Service Bus for production multi-instance deployments.
Shared zero-dependency enums and POCOs reused by Oluso.Core entities and the DTO projects.
SCIM 2.0 provisioning support for Oluso. Professional tier and above.
Wire-contract DTOs for the Oluso platform module. Shared by backend controllers and mobile clients.
FIDO2/WebAuthn Passkey support for Oluso. Professional tier and above.
Shared infrastructure for Oluso Azure Functions projects — tenant job dispatching and common utilities.
Wire-contract DTOs for Oluso business (KYB) verification. Shared by backend controllers and clients.
Wire-contract DTOs for the Oluso Account module. Shared by backend controllers and mobile clients.
Business (KYB) verification for Oluso: company registry checks through Dojah and Youverify, provider-hosted verification sessions, a journey step, document uploads and reviewer workflow.
Modern OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect identity server for ASP.NET Core. Multi-tenant, extensible, with User Journey Engine for customizable authentication flows.
SAML 2.0 Service Provider and Identity Provider support for Oluso. Enterprise tier.
Account API controllers for Oluso identity server. Provides REST endpoints for end-user self-service: profile, security settings, sessions, and connected applications.
Azure Key Vault integration for Oluso identity platform. Provides HSM-backed signing key management where private keys never leave the vault.
Core abstractions and domain entities for Oluso identity server.

Shared ASP.NET Core data protection key ring for Oluso hosts: keys kept in Azure Blob Storage and wrapped with an Azure Key Vault key, so the platform, its function apps and companion sites can read what each other protects and it survives redeploys.
OpenTelemetry implementation for Oluso telemetry. Provides metrics, tracing, and logging via the OpenTelemetry standard.
Azure Blob Storage IFileUploader implementation for Oluso identity platform. Provides container-based file storage with SAS URL signing, content hashing, and access tier control.
Admin API controllers for Oluso identity server. Provides REST endpoints for user, role, client, and policy management.
LDAP/Active Directory authentication and user sync for Oluso. Enterprise tier.
Telemetry abstractions for Oluso. Vendor-neutral interfaces for metrics, tracing, and logging.
Cloudflare integration for Oluso identity platform. Provisions custom tenant domains via Cloudflare Custom Hostnames API (SSL for SaaS).
Default UI views for Oluso User Journey Engine. Provides ready-to-use views for login, signup, MFA, and other authentication steps. Optional package - customize or replace with your own views.
Source generators for Oluso event property definitions.
Wire-contract DTOs for the Oluso Admin module. Shared by backend controllers and frontend clients.
Entity Framework Core stores for Oluso identity server. Supports SQL Server, PostgreSQL, SQLite.

C flexible array members for .NET: a fixed header with a contiguous trailing element sequence in one allocation, exposed as typed span and memory views with C-ABI-faithful layout measurements, self-describing parsing, and declaration-only pointer marshalling for [LibraryImport] interop.

Broker-neutral messaging for OLAX services: a transactional outbox and inbox on the service's EF Core DbContext, published and consumed directly, by broker push or through the OLAX messaging relay. Add a transport package for the broker (RabbitMq, GooglePubSub, AmazonSqs, AzureServiceBus).
Integration event contracts for OLAX services: IntegrationEvent, IEventPublisher and IIntegrationEventHandler. No EF Core or broker dependency, so the Application layer can reference it.
AWS transport for OLAX.InnovativeLab.Messaging: one SNS topic fanned out to one SQS queue per service, filtered by event name, with a redrive dead-letter queue.
Azure Service Bus transport for OLAX.InnovativeLab.Messaging: one topic, one subscription per service with a correlation rule per event, and the built-in dead-letter queue.
Typed HTTP client for the DsgWeb REST API, which starts and stops MQTT data streams generated by the DataStreamGenerator.
Google Cloud Pub/Sub transport for OLAX.InnovativeLab.Messaging: a topic per event, a subscription per service and event, dead-letter topics, and native push to Cloud Run with OIDC verification.

Kafka transport for OLAX.InnovativeLab.Messaging, also serving Azure Event Hubs through its Kafka endpoint: three topics (events, retry, dead-letter), a consumer group per service, retries and dead letters built on topics.
RabbitMQ transport for OLAX.InnovativeLab.Messaging: a topic exchange, one quorum queue per service, publisher confirms and a dead-letter queue.
